sentences.zh: 若聽民自販，必致蒙鹽內侵。

translations.literal: If one listens to the people selling on their own, it will surely cause Mongolian salt to invade inward.
translations.idiomatic: If private trade is allowed, Mongolian salt will inevitably flood in.

sentences.zh: 商人之力，不患寡，患不均。

translations.literal: Among merchants' strength, one does not worry about scarcity but about unevenness.
translations.idiomatic: Among merchants the problem is not too few hands but unequal distribution.

sentences.zh: 其弊有三：奸商棄瘠據肥，一也；

translations.literal: Its abuses have three: unscrupulous merchants abandon lean and occupy fat—one;
translations.idiomatic: There are three abuses: unscrupulous merchants abandon poor allotments and seize rich ones—first;

sentences.zh: 費浮地遠，夥攫其利，二也；

translations.literal: Costs float and lands are distant, partners grab the profit—two;
translations.idiomatic: distant routes with high costs let partners monopolize the profit—second;

sentences.zh: 僉代之期，貧富倒置，三也。

translations.literal: The term of collective replacement inverts rich and poor—three.
translations.idiomatic: and rotation schedules invert rich and poor—third.

sentences.zh: 」乃總三省引地為三等均之。

translations.literal: " He then totaled the three provinces' quota lands into three equal grades and equalized them.
translations.idiomatic: " He then consolidated the salt allocation territories of three provinces into three equal grades.

sentences.zh: 復以道路遠近順配為五十六路，鬮分簽掣之，於是賂絕弊清。

translations.literal: Further, according to the nearness and distance of roads he arranged them into fifty-six routes, divided by lot and drawn by ballot, and thus bribes ceased and abuses were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: He then assigned fifty-six routes by distance, distributing them by lottery, and bribery ceased and abuses were cleared.

sentences.zh: 後乾隆末廢商運，蒙鹽果內侵，至嘉慶十一年，仍復舊制，皆如所預計。

translations.literal: Later, at the end of Qianlong, merchant transport was abolished, Mongolian salt indeed invaded inward, and by the eleventh year of Jiaqing the old system was restored—all as he had foreseen.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at the end of the Qianlong reign, merchant transport was abolished and Mongolian salt did flood in as he had predicted; by the eleventh year of Jiaqing the old system was restored, exactly as he had foreseen.

sentences.zh: 所至興學愛士，人文蔚起。

translations.literal: Wherever he arrived he promoted learning and cherished scholars, and local culture flourished and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere he served he promoted learning and nurtured scholars, and local culture flourished.

sentences.zh: 以母老乞終養，居鄉多善舉。

translations.literal: Because his mother was old he begged leave for lifelong nurture, and while living in his home district he performed many good deeds.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother grew old he requested leave to care for her, and in retirement he undertook many charitable works.

sentences.zh: 著味鐙齋詩文集。

translations.literal: He authored the Wei Deng Studio collected poetry and prose.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote the Collected Poetry and Prose of the Wei Deng Studio.

sentences.zh: 方昂，字坳堂，山東歷城人。

translations.literal: Fang Ang, styled Aotang, was a man of Licheng, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Ang, whose courtesy name was Aotang, came from Licheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年進士，授刑部主事，累晉郎中。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments and was repeatedly promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the thirty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Ministry of Punishments as a principal clerk, and rose to department director.

sentences.zh: 會秋讞更新例，凡金刃殺人，概為情實。

translations.literal: It happened that autumn case review updated the regulations: all killings with metal blades were generally treated as cases warranting execution.
translations.idiomatic: When autumn case review adopted new regulations, every murder committed with a blade was classified as a capital offense.

sentences.zh: 昂分別其輕重，固爭不得，後高宗特旨改正。

translations.literal: Ang distinguished their light and heavy, firmly argued but could not prevail; later Gaozong by special edict corrected it.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Ang distinguished between serious and minor cases and argued against the blanket rule without success; later the Qianlong Emperor issued a special edict correcting the policy.

sentences.zh: 坐是為同僚所忌，淹滯十年。

translations.literal: Because of this he was envied by colleagues and stagnated for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: For this his colleagues resented him, and he languished in the same post for ten years.

sentences.zh: 又數上書與長官爭，長官慍之，卒重其人。

translations.literal: He also repeatedly submitted memorials disputing with superiors; the superiors were angry with him, but in the end valued the man.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials disputing his superiors, who grew angry yet ultimately came to respect his integrity.

sentences.zh: 以薦出為江西饒州知府。

translations.literal: On recommendation he went out as prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended for promotion, he was appointed prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 安南阮光平入覲，驛傳所經，多飾供帳。

translations.literal: Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam came to audience; along the post stations he passed, many decorated provisions and tents.
translations.idiomatic: When Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam came to pay tribute, post stations along his route were lavishly decorated.

sentences.zh: 昂曰：「國家以威德服四夷，非誇以靡麗。

translations.literal: Ang said: "The state by power and virtue subdues the four barbarians, not by boasting with extravagant splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Ang said: "The empire wins over foreign peoples through power and virtue, not by dazzling them with extravagance.

sentences.zh: 」戒所屬勿與。

translations.literal: " He warned his subordinates not to participate.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered his subordinates not to contribute.

sentences.zh: 擢江蘇蘇松道，已受代將行，營弁緝鹽，波及良善，眾洶洶不平。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Suzhou-Songjiang circuit; already having received his replacement and about to depart, camp officers pursued salt and the dragnet touched the innocent; the crowd was in noisy uproar and discontent.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to intendant of Suzhou and Songjiang, he was finishing his handover when military officers conducting a salt crackdown ensnared innocent people, and public outrage boiled over.

sentences.zh: 營弁以民變告，且徵兵，昂曰：「新守與民未習，民勿信。

translations.literal: The camp officers reported a popular uprising and also requested troops; Ang said: "The new prefect and the people are not yet familiar; the people will not trust him.
translations.idiomatic: The officers reported a popular uprising and requested troops; Fang Ang said: "The incoming prefect is unknown to the people and will not be trusted.

sentences.zh: 」自出曉諭，捕倡首者置法，申請上官褫營弁職，事即定。

translations.literal: " He himself went out to announce and instruct, captured the ringleaders and applied the law, memorialized superiors to strip the camp officers of office, and the affair was immediately settled.
translations.idiomatic: " He went out personally to announce the government's position, arrested the ringleaders and punished them, and petitioned to dismiss the officers; the disturbance was quickly settled.

sentences.zh: 至任，有尼之者，遂謝病去官。

translations.literal: When he reached his post, there were those who obstructed him, and he then begged leave for illness and left office.
translations.idiomatic: After taking office, obstruction from rivals led him to resign citing illness.

sentences.zh: 病痊，復出署松太道。

translations.literal: When his illness healed, he again went out to act as intendant of Song and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Once recovered, he returned as acting intendant of Songjiang and Taicang.

sentences.zh: 閩，廣洋盜竄入吳淞，總督、巡撫、提督會師於寶山。

translations.literal: Fujian and Guangdong sea pirates slipped into Wusong; the governor-general, governor, and provincial military commander assembled troops at Baoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Guangdong sea pirates infiltrated Wusong, and the governor-general, governor, and provincial military commander assembled forces at Baoshan.

sentences.zh: 昂建議曰：「衢山與大小羊山，江、浙之分界，港汊叢雜，盜船隨處可寄椗。

translations.literal: Ang submitted a proposal, saying: "Qushan and the large and small Yangshan islands are the boundary between Jiang and Zhe; harbors and channels are tangled and complex, and pirate ships can anchor anywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Ang proposed: "Qushan and the large and small Yangshan islands mark the boundary between Jiangsu and Zhejiang; the waterways are tangled, and pirate vessels can anchor anywhere.

sentences.zh: 一得風潮之便，倏忽出沒，猝不及防。

translations.literal: Once they gain the convenience of wind and tide, they suddenly appear and vanish, impossible to guard against in haste.
translations.idiomatic: Once they catch favorable wind and tides, they appear and vanish before defenses can react.

sentences.zh: 當其乘風而來，迎擊之時，彼順而我逆；

translations.literal: When they ride the wind and come, at the time of meeting their attack, they are with the current and we are against it;
translations.idiomatic: When they sail in with the wind, defenders must meet them head-on while the pirates have the advantage;

sentences.zh: 及其趁潮而退，追擊之，則我後而彼先：是使盜常憑胜勢也。

translations.literal: when they seize the tide and retreat, in pursuing and striking them, we are behind and they are ahead: this makes pirates constantly rely on a winning position.
translations.idiomatic: when they retreat with the tide, pursuers lag behind—giving pirates a constant tactical advantage.

sentences.zh: 請於要隘多設伏，俟其至，則縱使過，而躡其後；

translations.literal: I request that at strategic passes many ambushes be set; when they arrive, then let them pass, and follow on their rear;
translations.idiomatic: I recommend posting ambushes at key chokepoints: let pirates pass through, then follow from behind;

sentences.zh: 遇其退，則扼不使前，以待後隊之追剿。

translations.literal: when meeting their retreat, then block and do not let them advance, to await the rear force's pursuit and extermination.
translations.idiomatic: when they retreat, block their advance so rear forces can close in.

sentences.zh: 盜雖黠，無能為也。

translations.literal: Though pirates are cunning, they can do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Even clever pirates will be helpless.

sentences.zh: 」從其議，盜果大摧。

translations.literal: " His proposal was followed, and pirates indeed suffered great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: " His plan was adopted, and the pirates suffered a major defeat.

sentences.zh: 補江寧鹽巡道。

translations.literal: He was appointed to the Jiangning salt patrol circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed salt patrol intendant for Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 緝訟師，剔衙蠹，戢強暴，弭盜賊，尤以砥礪風俗為先，屏絕​​酬酢。

translations.literal: He pursued litigation masters, eliminated yamen parasites, restrained the violent, quelled bandits and thieves, especially taking refining customs as foremost, and screened off all social courtesies.
translations.idiomatic: He suppressed litigation brokers, eliminated yamen parasites, restrained the violent, quelled banditry, and above all set about refining local customs, cutting off all social entertaining and courtesies.

sentences.zh: 同官聞其風采，咸重之。

translations.literal: Colleagues who heard of his bearing all respected him.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues who witnessed his rigor all held him in high regard.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，擢貴州按察使，八閱月，遷江寧布政使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Guizhou; after eight months he was transferred to administration commissioner of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner of Guizhou, and eight months later transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 未久，以病乞歸。

translations.literal: Not long after, on grounds of illness he begged to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he resigned and returned home on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 昂剛勁勤職。

translations.literal: Ang was stern, resolute, and diligent in office.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Ang was stern, resolute, and diligent in duty.

sentences.zh: 其歸也，上曰：「此人可惜！

translations.literal: When he returned home, the emperor said: "This man is regrettable to lose!
translations.idiomatic: When he left office, the emperor said: "This man is a loss!

sentences.zh: 」尋卒。

translations.literal: " Soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: " He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 唐侍陛，字贊宸，江蘇江都人，巡撫綏祖孫。

translations.literal: Tang Shibi, styled Zanchen, was a man of Jiangdu, Jiangsu, grandson of the governor Suizu.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shibi, whose courtesy name was Zanchen, came from Jiangdu in Jiangsu and was the grandson of Governor Suizu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，以廕生授南河山盱通判。

translations.literal: During Qianlong, by hereditary privilege he was appointed assistant prefect of Nanhe, Shan, and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he entered service through hereditary privilege as assistant prefect at Nanhe, Shan, and Huai.

sentences.zh: 歷任宿虹、銅沛、里河、外河同知。

translations.literal: He successively served as sub-prefect of Su-Hong, Tong-Pei, Inner River, and Outer River.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as sub-prefect at Suqian and Hongze, Tongshan and Peixian, the inner canal, and the outer canal.

sentences.zh: 以治河績考最，擢湖北鄖陽知府，母憂去官。

translations.literal: Because his river-control record ranked highest in evaluation, he was promoted to prefect of Yunyang in Hubei; on his mother's mourning he left office.
translations.idiomatic: Recognized for outstanding river-control work, he was promoted to prefect of Yunyang in Hubei but left office upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，服闋，會河決青龍岡，屢築屢圮，大學士阿桂督治，以侍陛習河事，疏調赴工。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, when mourning ended, it happened that the river breached at Qinglong Hill, repeatedly built and repeatedly collapsed; Grand Secretary Agui supervised the repair, and because Shibi was versed in river affairs, memorialized to transfer him to the works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year, after mourning ended, the Yellow River breached at Qinglong Hill with repeated failed repairs; Grand Secretary Agui took charge and requested Tang Shibi's transfer, citing his river expertise.

sentences.zh: 阿桂方與總河議改河之策，決計於侍陛，侍陛曰：「今全河下注，非土埽所能當；

translations.literal: Agui was just then discussing with the director-general a policy to change the river and decided the plan on Shibi; Shibi said: "Now the whole river pours down; earthen fascines cannot withstand it;
translations.idiomatic: Agui was debating river diversion strategies with the director-general when he decided to consult Tang Shibi, who said: "With the entire river pouring through, earthen fascines cannot hold it;

sentences.zh: 欲逆挽歸正道，難矣。

translations.literal: wanting to turn back against the current and return it to the correct channel is difficult.
translations.idiomatic: forcing the current back to the proper channel would be nearly impossible.

sentences.zh: 但於南岸上游百里外開引河，則不與急流爭，其全勢易掣。

translations.literal: But if one opens a diversion channel a hundred li upstream on the south bank, then one does not contend with the rushing current, and its full force is easily drawn off.
translations.idiomatic: Instead, open a diversion channel a hundred li upstream on the south bank; that avoids competing with the rapid current and more easily draws off the full force.

sentences.zh: 以逸待勞，此上策也。

translations.literal: Using ease to await exhaustion—this is the upper strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Using steady effort against rushing water—this is the best approach.

sentences.zh: 」於是定計開蘭陽引河，至商丘歸正河，以侍陛總其事。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they fixed the plan to open the Lanyang diversion channel, returning to the correct river at Shangqiu, with Shibi overseeing the whole affair.
translations.idiomatic: " They decided to open the Lanyang diversion channel returning to the proper riverbed at Shangqiu, with Tang Shibi directing the work.

sentences.zh: 工成，被詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: When the work was completed, he received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When the project was completed, he received imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 擢開歸道。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Kaifeng-Guide circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to intendant of Kaifeng and Guide.

sentences.zh: 時新引河堤初成，溜逼甚險，复於儀封十六堡增開引河。

translations.literal: At that time the new diversion embankment was just completed, the current pressed close and was very perilous, and again at the sixteen forts of Yifeng an additional diversion channel was opened.
translations.idiomatic: When the new diversion embankment was barely finished and the current pressed dangerously close, he opened another diversion at the sixteen forts of Yifeng.

sentences.zh: 夏汛水至，果分為二派：一由新引河，一由儀封舊城之南達所增引河。

translations.literal: When summer floodwaters arrived, they indeed divided into two branches: one by the new diversion channel, one south of Yifeng old city reaching the added diversion channel.
translations.idiomatic: When summer floods arrived, the water split into two branches: one through the new Lanyang channel, one south of old Yifeng city to the added diversion.

sentences.zh: 又於毛家寨增築月堤，睢汛七堡建挑水壩，水勢乃暢下，無潰決。

translations.literal: Further, at Maojiazhai he added moon embankments, and at the seven forts of the Sui flood he built water-diverting dams; the water's force then flowed freely downward without breach.
translations.idiomatic: He also built moon embankments at Maojiazhai and spur dams at the seven forts of the Sui River, allowing the current to flow freely without breach.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，署彰衛懷道。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year he acted as intendant of Zhang, Wei, and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year he served as acting intendant of Zhang, Wei, and Huai.

sentences.zh: 測河勢將有變，請於銅瓦廂大堤後增築撐堤，總河蘭錫第以無故興大工難之，固請乃可。

translations.literal: Surveying the river's force, he saw change would come and requested building support embankments behind the Tongwa Lane great dike; Director-General Lan Xidi found it difficult because there was no cause to raise a great work, but after firm petitioning it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Surveying the river, he predicted change coming and requested building support embankments behind the Tongwa Lane great dike; Director-General Lan Xidi resisted unnecessary major works until Tang Shibi persisted and won approval.

sentences.zh: 次年夏，銅瓦工內塌，勢岌岌。

translations.literal: The next summer, the Tongwa works collapsed inward, and the situation was perilously precarious.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer the Tongwa work collapsed inward, and the situation grew perilous.

sentences.zh: 總河李奉翰新至，視河、曰：「奈何？

translations.literal: Director-General Li Fenghan had newly arrived; he viewed the river and said: "What is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: The newly arrived director-general Li Fenghan looked at the river and said: "What can we do?

sentences.zh: 」侍陛曰：「待其塌多，必大決。

translations.literal: " Shibi said: "Wait until much has collapsed, and there will surely be a great breach.
translations.idiomatic: " Tang Shibi said: "If we wait until more collapses, there will surely be a major breach.

sentences.zh: 今當於堤之下口新築撐堤內掘開數丈，使水回溜而入。

translations.literal: Now one ought at the lower mouth of the dike newly to build support embankments and excavate several zhang within, causing water to flow back in eddy and enter.
translations.idiomatic: We should now build support embankments at the lower opening of the dike and excavate several zhang within to let water flow back inward in a reverse eddy.

sentences.zh: 入必淤，淤則大堤撐堤合為一。

translations.literal: When water enters it must silt up; once silted, the main dike and the support dike merge into one.
translations.idiomatic: The water would inevitably deposit silt; once silted, the main embankment and the support embankment would fuse into a single barrier.

sentences.zh: 河直注之力已殺，堤乃可保。

translations.literal: The river's force of direct pouring would be killed, and only then could the dike be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: The river's straight-on rush would be broken, and the dike could then be saved.

sentences.zh: 」從之，堤合險平。

translations.literal: " They followed this; the dikes merged and the peril was settled.
translations.idiomatic: " They followed his plan; the embankments joined and the danger subsided.

sentences.zh: 錫第曰：「君之出奇制勝者，在前之預築撐堤也。

translations.literal: Xi Di said: "Your victory through unexpected stratagem lay in the support dike you built in advance beforehand."
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xidi said, "Your stroke of genius was the support embankment you had built in advance."
End of quotation.

sentences.zh: 侍陛前官銅沛時，亦用放淤平險之法；

translations.literal: When Shibi had earlier served at Tongpei, he also used the method of releasing silt to level peril;
translations.idiomatic: While serving at Tongpei earlier, he had likewise used the method of deliberate silt release to ease dangerous conditions;

sentences.zh: 又在宿虹時，夏家馬路黃、運交逼，里河淤淺，水將沒堤，效黃河清水龍法，疏其淤而堤安；

translations.literal: Again at Suhong, at the Xia family horse road the Yellow and Transport rivers pressed together, the inner river silted shallow, water was about to overtop the dike; he imitated the Yellow River clear-water dragon method, dredged the silt, and the dike was secure;
translations.idiomatic: At Suhong, where the Yellow and Grand Canal pressed together at the Xia family horse road, the inner channel had silted up and water threatened the dike; he adapted the Yellow River "clear-water dragon" dredging technique, cleared the silt, and secured the embankment;

sentences.zh: 於徐州城外增築石工，石磯嘴增爛石，城乃無患。

translations.literal: Outside Xuzhou city he added stone works; at the stone jetty mouth he added broken stone, and the city was then without trouble.
translations.idiomatic: He added stonework outside Xuzhou and piled rubble at the stone jetty, so the city was no longer threatened.

sentences.zh: 衛河水弱，漕艘不利，掘地引沁挾濟以助衛。

translations.literal: The Wei River water was weak and grain transport vessels were hindered; he dug channels to draw the Qin River, carrying Ji River water to assist the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: When the weak Wei River impeded grain barges, he dug channels to divert the Qin and bring Ji River water to bolster the Wei.

sentences.zh: 其應變弭患多類此。

translations.literal: His responses to change and quelling of calamities were mostly of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Most of his improvisations against flood and transport crises followed this pattern.

sentences.zh: 嘗論治河之道曰：「河行挾沙，治法宜激之使怒而直以暢其勢，曲以殺其威。

translations.literal: He once discussed the way of governing rivers, saying: "The river in its course carries sand; the method of treatment should rouse it to anger and make it straight to release its momentum, and bend it to kill its power."
translations.idiomatic: He once summed up river governance: "A river carries sand as it runs; the art is to stir its current to full force along a straight course, and bend it where its power must be broken."

sentences.zh: 無廢工而不可偪，無爭土而不可讓。

translations.literal: There is no wasted labor that cannot be pressed, no disputed earth that cannot be yielded.
translations.idiomatic: No work is wasted if you press hard enough; no contested ground is surrendered if you know when to yield.

sentences.zh: 守此岸則慮彼岸，治上游則慮下游。

translations.literal: To defend this bank is to worry over the far bank; to treat the upper reaches is to worry over the lower reaches.
translations.idiomatic: Guard one bank and you must think of the other; fix the upper reach and you must think of what lies below.

sentences.zh: 」世以為名言。

translations.literal: " The age regarded this as a famous saying.
translations.idiomatic: " His contemporaries treated these lines as a classic maxim.

sentences.zh: 尋補山東運河道，調兗沂曹濟道。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed to the Shandong grain-transport circuit and transferred to the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed grain-transport intendant of Shandong, then transferred to the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit.

sentences.zh: 以失察，左遷。

translations.literal: For failure of supervision he was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted for a supervisory lapse.

sentences.zh: 遂乞病歸。

translations.literal: He then petitioned to retire on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 侍陛歷官皆有聲，有功於河、淮者為多。

translations.literal: Throughout his offices Shibi left a reputation everywhere; most of his achievements were on the Yellow and Huai rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Shibi won renown at every post he held, above all for service on the Yellow and Huai rivers.

sentences.zh: 先是南汝光道張沖之以治河著。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhang Chongzhi of the Nan-Ru-Guang circuit had been noted for governing rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier still, Zhang Chongzhi of the Nan-Ru-Guang circuit had been famed for river work.

sentences.zh: 沖之，字道淵，順天宛平人。

translations.literal: Chongzhi, styled Daoyuan, was a man of Wanping, Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chongzhi, whose courtesy name was Daoyuan, came from Wanping in the Shuntian metropolitan district.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，以諸生舉孝廉方正，授工部主事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng, as a student he was nominated as Filial and Incorrupt and appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign he was nominated as a Filial and Incorrupt scholar and appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 遇事奮厲，於總理果親王前持議無避忌。

translations.literal: When matters arose he was vigorous and bold; before Prince Guo, who oversaw affairs, he held to his views without avoidance.
translations.idiomatic: He threw himself boldly into every task and spoke his mind without reserve even before Prince Guo, who oversaw state affairs.

sentences.zh: 各行省奏追虧帑積數千萬，牘冗無實，請分別覈免之。

translations.literal: Each province memorialized to pursue treasury deficits accumulated in the tens of millions; the documents were redundant and without substance; he requested separate examination and remission.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were pressing to recover tens of millions in accumulated treasury shortfalls, but the paperwork was bloated and groundless; he urged that each case be audited and remitted separately.

sentences.zh: 尋以事被謫。

translations.literal: Soon he was demoted on account of an affair.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon demoted over a political dispute.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，復原官，改刑部。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he was restored to his original office and transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he was restored to office and transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 治事平恕。

translations.literal: In handling affairs he was even and forgiving.
translations.idiomatic: He handled affairs with fairness and leniency.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，擢河南南汝光道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to the Nan-Ru-Guang circuit in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to intendant of the Nan-Ru-Guang circuit in Henan.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，河決楊橋，大學士劉統勳、兆惠奉命往塞之，調沖之襄河事。

translations.literal: That autumn the river burst at Yangqiao; Grand Secretaries Liu Tongxun and Zhaohui were ordered to go and block it; Chongzhi was transferred to assist in river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Yellow River broke through at Yangqiao. Grand Secretaries Liu Tongxun and Zhaohui were dispatched to seal the breach, and Chongzhi was called in to assist.

sentences.zh: 時徵秸，價騰至一莖兩錢，既大集，河員猶以多備請，官吏在事者群附和之。

translations.literal: At the time straw was requisitioned; the price soared to two cash per stalk; after a great gathering, river officials still requested extra reserves, and officials involved all chimed in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Straw was being requisitioned at prices as high as two cash per stalk. Even after ample supplies had been gathered, river officials still demanded more, and every officer on the project echoed them.

sentences.zh: 沖之曰：「計工需料若干萬，今已贏矣。

translations.literal: Chongzhi said: "Calculating the works, the materials needed are so many tens of thousands; we already have a surplus."
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhi said, "The project requires a fixed quantity of materials, and we already have more than enough."

sentences.zh: 災民搜括脂髓來供用，忍复乘以為利耶？

translations.literal: Disaster victims have been squeezed to the marrow to supply this—how can we bear to multiply it again for profit?
translations.idiomatic: Disaster victims have already been squeezed dry to supply this work—how can we squeeze them again for profit?"

sentences.zh: 」亟白使臣，請及時楗塞，期以某日合龍，當有餘料若干萬，力持其議。

translations.literal: " He urgently informed the commissioners, requesting timely blocking and sealing, fixing a date for the dragon's closure, when there would be surplus materials of so many tens of thousands; he forcefully held to this view.
translations.idiomatic: " He urgently reported to the commissioners, urging that the breach be sealed promptly and setting a date for closure by which surplus materials would remain; he held firmly to this position.

sentences.zh: 卒聽沖之減徵秫稭六千萬、麻六百萬，即責沖之董其役，果如期合龍，仍有餘料，殫數給還，以紓民力。

translations.literal: In the end they listened to Chongzhi and reduced requisition of sorghum stalks by sixty million and hemp by six million; they immediately charged Chongzhi to supervise the labor; indeed on schedule the dragon was closed, and there was still surplus material; the full count was returned to ease the people's burden.
translations.idiomatic: They finally accepted Chongzhi's proposal, cutting requisitions by sixty million sorghum stalks and six million units of hemp, and put him in charge of the work. The breach was closed on schedule with materials to spare, every surplus item returned to ease the people's burden.

sentences.zh: 巡撫胡寶瑔喜曰：「吾為國家得一良總河矣！

translations.literal: Governor Hu Baoheng said with delight: "I have obtained for the state a fine director-general of rivers!"
translations.idiomatic: Governor Hu Baoheng exclaimed with delight, "The state has gained an excellent Director-General of Rivers!"

sentences.zh: 」在官三年，治羅山獄，活誣服者四人；

translations.literal: " During three years in office he handled the Luoshan prison case and saved four who had confessed under false coercion;
translations.idiomatic: " In three years of service he handled the Luoshan prison case and saved four men who had confessed under coercion;

sentences.zh: 修城工務覈實，有司不得緣為蠹；

translations.literal: city-wall repair projects were audited for substance, and local officials could not use them as pretexts for corruption;
translations.idiomatic: he audited city-wall repairs so thoroughly that local officials could not use them as pretexts for graft;

sentences.zh: 民德之。

translations.literal: the people were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: and the people were grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 以商城獄坐徇庇，奪職，效力軍台。

translations.literal: For the Shangcheng prison case he was punished for favoritism, stripped of office, and ordered to serve at a military post.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for showing favoritism in the Shangcheng prison case and sent to serve at a military frontier post.

sentences.zh: 逾年放歸。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was released to return.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was released to return home.

sentences.zh: 論曰：諸道本以佐布政、按察二使分領郡、縣；

translations.literal: The commentary says: Circuit intendants were originally to assist the provincial administration commissioner and surveillance commissioner in dividing governance of prefectures and counties;
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: Circuit intendants were originally meant to assist the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners in governing prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，罷參政、參議、副使、僉事，道始為專官。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period, administration commissioners, administration councillors, vice commissioners, and surveillance vice commissioners were abolished, and the circuit became a specialized post.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the old ranks of administration commissioner, councillor, vice commissioner, and surveillance vice commissioner were abolished, and the circuit intendant became a specialized post in its own right.

sentences.zh: 士寬等皆觥觥能舉其職，侍陛尤以治河著。

translations.literal: Shikuan and the others were all upright and able to fulfill their duties; Shibi was especially noted for governing rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Shikuan and his colleagues were all upright men who discharged their duties well; Shibi was especially renowned for river governance.

sentences.zh: 觀其所設施，益於國，澤於民，雖古循吏，不是過也。

translations.literal: Observing what they enacted, it benefited the state and showered grace on the people; even ancient model officials would not surpass them.
translations.idiomatic: Judging by what they accomplished, they enriched the state and brought relief to the people—worthy of comparison with the model officials of antiquity, and no less.
